title: Creamy Jubilant Fettuccine
description: A rich and satisfying pasta dish featuring jubilant sauce and fettuccine pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the fettuccine pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the jubilant and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the dutch, if using, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked fettuccine and add to the skillet with the jubilant sauce.
Toss to coat the pasta evenly.
